subject: maths
title: Angles as Turns: Quarter, Half and Full Turns and Right Angles
seo_title: Year 3 Angles as Turns Worksheets: Right Angles, Quarter and Half Turns (Free, Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify angles as measures of turn and compare angles with right angles in everyday situations
meta_desc: Free Year 3 maths worksheets on angles as turns: quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns, clockwise and anticlockwise, right angles in shapes and everyday objects, and angles greater or less than a right angle. 100 questions with an answer key, following the Australian Curriculum (AC9M3M05) for NAPLAN practice.
key_big: An angle is a turn. A quarter turn makes a right angle: a square corner.
key_sub: A half turn is 2 right angles, a three-quarter turn is 3 and a full turn is 4. Compare every angle with a right angle: narrower is less, wider is greater. Arm length does not change an angle.
body_html:
An angle is a turn

An angle measures how far something turns. Clock hands turn clockwise. The other way is anticlockwise.

TurnQuarter turnsRight angles
Quarter turn11
Half turn22 (a straight line)
Three-quarter turn33
Full turn44 (back to the start)
Example

Mia faces north. She makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does she face now?

Clockwise goes north, east, south, west. One quarter turn from north is east.

Answer: east

Example

Jack faces east. He makes a half turn. Which way does he face now?

A half turn makes you face the opposite way. West is opposite east.

Answer: west

A quarter turn makes a right angle

A right angle is a square corner. It is the angle a quarter turn makes. A small square in a corner shows a right angle.

Make a right-angle checker: fold a piece of paper in half, then in half again.

Greater than or less than a right angle

Put your checker in the angle. If the angle is narrower, it is less than a right angle. If it is wider, it is greater than a right angle.

Example

At 5 o’clock, what angle do the hands of an analog clock make?

A right angle is 3 hour marks (like 3 o’clock). 5 hour marks is wider.

Answer: greater than a right angle

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Thinking longer arms make a bigger angleLook at how far the angle turns, not the arm length
Mixing up clockwise and anticlockwiseClockwise is the way clock hands go
Mixing up a half turn and a quarter turnA half turn faces the opposite way; a quarter turn is a square corner
Saying a tilted right angle is not a right angleTurn the page or use a checker: tilting does not change an angle

faq.q: What is AC9M3M05 in the Australian Curriculum?
faq.a: It is the Year 3 maths content description “identify angles as measures of turn and compare angles with right angles in everyday situations”. Students learn quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns and compare angles with a right angle.

faq.q: How do you explain a right angle to a Year 3 child?
faq.a: A right angle is a square corner, like the corner of a book or a door. It is the angle you make with a quarter turn. Fold a piece of paper in half and in half again to make a right-angle checker.

faq.q: Do Year 3 students measure angles in degrees?
faq.a: No. In Year 3 students compare angles with a right angle. Angle names such as acute and obtuse come in Year 4, and measuring in degrees with a protractor comes in Year 5.

faq.q: Are angles and turns in the Year 3 NAPLAN numeracy test?
faq.a: NAPLAN numeracy is based on the Australian Curriculum, so questions about turns, right angles and compass directions can appear. Practising with clocks, compass points and everyday objects helps.

sets.title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns

items.q: Mei faces the window. She makes a full turn. What does she face now?
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round, so she faces the window again.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a three-quarter turn?
items.e: A three-quarter turn is 3 quarter turns.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a half turn?
items.e: A half turn is 2 quarter turns: a quarter and another quarter make a half.

items.q: Which turn takes you back to where you started?
items.e: A full turn goes all the way round, so you face the same way again.

items.q: What turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round. That is a quarter turn.
The arrow goes halfway round, so the end line points the opposite way. That is a half turn.
The arrow goes all the way round, back to the dashed line. That is a full turn.

items.q: Chloe says this turn is clockwise. Is she right?
c: No, it is a half turn
items.e: Clock hands go from 12 to 3, to the right at the top. This arrow goes to the left at the top: anticlockwise.

items.q: Which way do the hands on an analog clock turn?
items.e: Clock hands always turn the same way: clockwise. Anticlockwise is the opposite way.

items.q: How many quarter turns make a full turn?
items.e: A full turn is 4 quarter turns. Four quarters make one whole.

items.q: Ruby says this arrow shows a quarter turn. Is she right?
c: No, it is a half turn
Yes, it is a quarter turn
No, it is a full turn
No, it is a three-quarter turn
items.e: The end line points the opposite way to the dashed line. The arrow goes halfway round: a half turn.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round, the same way as clock hands. That is clockwise.

items.q: Which turn makes you face the opposite way?
items.e: A half turn goes halfway round, so you end up facing the opposite way.

items.q: Ethan and Lachlan both face the board. Ethan makes a half turn clockwise. Lachlan makes a half turn anticlockwise. What is true now?
items.e: A half turn either way ends facing the opposite way to the start. So they both face away from the board: the same way.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round, the same way as clock hands. That is clockwise.

items.q: Harper makes a quarter turn clockwise. Then she makes a half turn clockwise. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 1 quarter turn + 2 quarter turns = 3 quarter turns. That is a three-quarter turn.

items.q: A quarter turn clockwise ends facing the same way as which other turn?
items.e: Going 1 quarter one way ends in the same place as going 3 quarters the other way. 1 + 3 = 4 quarters, a full turn.

items.q: Which turn does the arrow show? It starts at the dashed line.
items.e: The arrow goes a quarter of the way round, the opposite way to clock hands. That is anticlockwise.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round. That is a three-quarter turn.
The arrow goes three quarters of the way round, the opposite way to clock hands. That is anticlockwise.

sets.title: A quarter turn makes a right angle

items.q: Grace says this is not a right angle because it is tilted. Is she right?
c: Yes, it is less than a right angle
Yes, it is greater than a right angle
No, it is still a right angle
No, it is a straight line
items.e: Turn the page and the arms make a square corner. Tilting an angle does not change its size.

items.q: How many right angles make a three-quarter turn?
items.e: A three-quarter turn is 3 quarter turns, so it is 3 right angles.

items.q: Liam faces west. He makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which way does he face now?
items.e: A quarter turn anticlockwise goes from west to south. Anticlockwise goes N, W, S, E.

items.q: Jack faces north. He turns until he faces south. How many right angles has he turned through?
items.e: North to south is a half turn: north to east is 1 right angle, east to south is 1 more. That is 2.

items.q: The arrow shows a quarter turn. What angle do the dashed line and the solid line make?
items.e: A quarter turn makes a right angle between the start line and the end line.

items.q: Isla turns clockwise through 1 right angle, then 1 more right angle. What turn is that altogether?
items.e: 1 right angle + 1 right angle = 2 right angles. 2 quarter turns make a half turn.

items.q: Mia faces south. She makes a half turn clockwise. Which way does she face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. North is opposite south.

items.q: Two right angles side by side make what?
items.e: 2 right angles make a half turn. The two outside arms point opposite ways, so they make a straight line.

items.q: Which angle is a right angle?
items.e: Picture A makes a square corner. It is tilted, but it is still a right angle. Check with the corner of a piece of paper.

items.q: How many right angles make a quarter turn?
items.e: A quarter turn makes 1 right angle.

items.q: Matilda folds a piece of paper in half, then in half again. What does the folded corner make?
c: an angle greater than a right angle
items.e: The first fold makes a straight edge (a half turn). Folding that in half makes a quarter turn: a right angle. This is a right-angle checker.

items.q: Which angle is a right angle?
items.e: Picture D makes a square corner. Its arms are short, but arm length does not change an angle.

items.q: How many right angles make a half turn?
items.e: A half turn is 2 quarter turns, so it is 2 right angles.

items.q: Cooper faces north. He makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does he face now?
items.e: A quarter turn clockwise goes from north to east. Clockwise goes N, E, S, W.

items.q: Noah faces north. He turns clockwise until he faces west. How many right angles has he turned through?
items.e: Clockwise from north: east (1), south (2), west (3). That is 3 right angles: a three-quarter turn.

items.q: Sienna faces north. She makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. Which way does she face now?
items.e: A quarter turn anticlockwise goes from north to west. Anticlockwise goes N, W, S, E.

items.q: How many right angles make a full turn?
items.e: A full turn is 4 quarter turns, so it is 4 right angles.

items.q: A right angle is the same as which turn?
items.e: A right angle is a quarter turn: the corner you make when you turn a quarter of the way round.

items.q: What does the small square in the corner show?
items.e: A small square in a corner shows a right angle: a square corner, like the corner of a page.

items.q: Which turn is the same as 3 right angles?
items.e: Each right angle is a quarter turn. 3 quarter turns make a three-quarter turn.

sets.title: Right angles in shapes and everyday objects

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: A square has 4 right angles. It is turned, but turning does not change the angles.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: All 3 corners are smaller than a right angle, so there are no right angles.

items.q: Which object has no right angles?
items.e: Picture A is a give way sign. It is a triangle with 3 corners that are all less than a right angle. The others are rectangles.

items.q: How many right angles are inside the capital letter T?
items.e: Where the top line meets the stem, there is a right angle on each side. That is 2 right angles.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: The 2 bottom corners and the top of the roof are right angles. The 2 corners where the roof meets the walls are greater.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: The 2 corners on the left are right angles. The 2 corners on the right are not.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: 5 corners are square corners. The corner that points inwards is greater than a right angle, so do not count it.

items.q: Where can you find a right angle in the classroom?
c: the tip of a sharp pencil
the edge of a round clock
the edge of a dinner plate
items.e: The corner of a book is a square corner: a right angle. A pencil tip is less than a right angle, and round things have no corners.

items.q: This window has 4 panes of glass. How many right angles does one pane have?
items.e: Each pane is a rectangle, so it has 4 square corners: 4 right angles.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: 3 corners are still square corners. Cutting off a corner makes 2 corners that are greater than a right angle.

items.q: How many right angles does this shape have?
items.e: Only the bottom-left corner is a square corner. The other 2 corners are smaller.

items.q: How many right angles does this stop sign have?
items.e: A stop sign has 8 corners, but each one is greater than a right angle. So it has no right angles.

items.q: William says this shape has no right angles because it is turned. Is he right?
c: No, it still has 4 right angles
Yes, it has no right angles
Yes, turned shapes lose their corners
items.e: It is a rectangle that has been turned. Turning a shape does not change its angles, so it still has 4 right angles.

items.q: Ava checks the corners of her library book with a right-angle checker. How many corners are right angles?
items.e: The front cover is a rectangle. All 4 corners are square corners, so all 4 are right angles.

items.q: Oliver says the tip of this slice of pizza is a right angle. Is he right?
c: No, it is greater than a right angle
No, it is a straight line
Yes, it is a right angle
No, it is less than a right angle
items.e: The tip is much narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: Which object has a right angle at every corner?
items.e: Picture A is a door. It is a rectangle, so all 4 corners are right angles. The pizza slice, coat hanger and give way sign have pointy or wide corners.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 1 right angle?
items.e: Picture C is a triangle with one square corner. The rectangle has 4, the other triangle has none and the 4-sided shape has 2.

items.q: Which of these usually has 4 right angles?
items.e: A door is a rectangle, so it has 4 square corners. A pizza slice and a give way sign have pointy corners.

items.q: Which shape has no right angles?
items.e: Picture D leans over, so none of its corners are square corners. The turned square, the triangle and the L-shape all have right angles.

items.q: How many right angles are inside the capital letter L?
items.e: Where the 2 lines of L meet, the inside corner is 1 right angle.

sets.title: Greater than or less than a right angle

items.q: Which angle is less than a right angle?
items.e: Picture D is narrower than a square corner. The others are a right angle or wider.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle is narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle opens wider than a square corner, so it is greater than a right angle.

items.q: Aarav puts his right-angle checker into a corner of the classroom table. It fits exactly. What is the corner?
items.e: The checker is a right angle. If it fits exactly, with no gap and no overlap, the corner is a right angle too.

items.q: Which angle in this triangle is greater than a right angle?
items.e: Angle B, at the top, opens wider than a square corner. Angles A and C are narrow: less than a right angle.

items.q: Which angle is greater than a right angle?
items.e: Picture D opens wider than a square corner. Its arms are short, but that does not make it small.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle is narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle is narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle is narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The arms make a square corner, so it is a right angle. Tilting an angle does not change it.

items.q: Zara says this angle is greater than a right angle because its arms are long. Is she right?
c: No, it is less than a right angle
Yes, it is a straight line
No, it is a right angle
Yes, long arms make a big angle
items.e: Long arms do not make an angle bigger. This angle is narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The arms make a square corner, so it is a right angle. Tilting an angle does not change it.

items.q: Which angle is greater?
items.e: Angle Q opens wider than a right angle, and angle P is less than a right angle. So Q is greater, even though P has longer arms.

items.q: Put the angles in order from smallest to largest.
items.e: Y is less than a right angle, Z is a right angle and X is greater than a right angle. Look at the turn, not the arm length.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The arms point in opposite directions and make a straight line: 2 right angles (a half turn).

items.q: An angle is a bit more than a quarter turn. What is it?
items.e: A quarter turn is a right angle. A bit more than a quarter turn is greater than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle opens wider than a square corner, so it is greater than a right angle.

items.q: Kai says this angle is less than a right angle because its arms are short. Is he right?
c: Yes, short arms make a small angle
No, it is greater than a right angle
Yes, it is a small turn
No, it is a right angle
items.e: The size of an angle is how far it turns, not how long its arms are. This angle opens wider than a right angle.

items.q: Amelia puts her right-angle checker into an angle. The angle is wider than the checker. What is the angle?
items.e: The checker is a right angle. If the angle is wider than the checker, it is greater than a right angle.

items.q: Compare this angle with a right angle. What is it?
items.e: The angle opens wider than a square corner, so it is greater than a right angle.

items.q: How many minutes does the minute hand take to make a quarter turn?
items.e: A full turn of the minute hand takes 60 minutes. A quarter of 60 is 15, so a quarter turn takes 15 minutes.

items.q: What angle do the hands make?
items.e: At 3 o’clock the hands make a square corner: a right angle.

items.q: Angle A is where the ramp meets the ground. Compare it with a right angle.
items.e: The ramp slopes up gently. Angle A is much narrower than a square corner, so it is less than a right angle.

items.q: On a school excursion, Ethan faces north to read a map. He makes a half turn. Which way does he face now?
items.e: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. South is opposite north.

items.q: What angle do the hands make?
items.e: At 6 o’clock the hands point in opposite directions. They make a straight line: a half turn.

items.q: Charlotte walks north along the beach. She turns right. Which way is she walking now?
items.e: Turning right is a quarter turn clockwise. A quarter turn clockwise from north is east.

items.q: Ruby opens the classroom door until it makes a square corner with the wall. What turn has the door made?
items.e: A square corner is a right angle, and a right angle is a quarter turn.

items.q: This skateboard ramp sits on flat ground. Which corner of the ramp is a right angle?
items.e: At B the upright back of the ramp meets the flat ground. That makes a square corner: a right angle.

items.q: What angle do the hands make?
items.e: At 5 o’clock the hands are 5 hour marks apart. A right angle is only 3 hour marks, so this angle is greater.

items.q: From 12 noon to 3 pm, what turn does the hour hand make?
items.e: The hour hand moves from 12 to 3. That is a quarter of the way round the clock: a quarter turn.

items.q: The minute hand turns clockwise from the dashed line to where it is now. What turn has it made?
items.e: From 3 to 9 is halfway round the clock: a half turn.

items.q: Leo turns the garden tap on with a half turn. How many right angles has the handle turned through?
items.e: A half turn is 2 quarter turns, and each quarter turn is a right angle. So the handle turns through 2 right angles.

items.q: School starts at 8:45 am. The minute hand makes a half turn. What time is it now?
items.e: A half turn of the minute hand is 30 minutes. 30 minutes after 8:45 am is 9:15 am.

items.q: At the athletics carnival, Chloe runs once around the oval and ends where she started. What turn has she made?
items.e: Going all the way round and facing the same way again is a full turn.
The hand goes all the way round from 9 back to 9: a full turn.

items.q: Lachlan faces south. He makes a three-quarter turn anticlockwise. Which way does he face now?
items.e: Anticlockwise from south goes east (1), north (2), west (3). So he faces west.

items.q: What angle do the hands make?
items.e: At 1 o’clock the hands are only 1 hour mark apart. That is narrower than a right angle (3 hour marks).

items.q: The minute hand turns clockwise from the dashed line to where it is now. What turn has it made?
items.e: From 12 to 3 is a quarter of the way round the clock: a quarter turn.
From 6 round to 3 is 6 to 9, 9 to 12 and 12 to 3: 3 quarter turns. That is a three-quarter turn.

items.q: At the skate park, Mei rides forwards and then does a half turn on her skateboard. Which way is she facing now?
items.e: A half turn is 2 right angles, so she ends up facing the opposite way.
